s_tier.title: S Tier
s_tier._note: BLOCKED, but not for the reason I originally wrote -- FS/GS/H already exist as real routes in route_stops.json (confirmed by validate_quests.py NOT flagging them as missing). The real blocker is that the trip-logging UI can't select/log any individual shuttle yet (status.md: 'no shuttle is currently selectable anywhere in the trip-logging flow'). Since the resolver has no way to detect an app-UI fact from data, this needs an explicit blocked flag rather than relying on route-validity checking, which would otherwise let this resolve and ship an unwinnable quest. Flip blocked to false once shuttle selection ships.

n_legger.title: 5-Legger
n_legger.description: Log a single trip with at least {count} legs.
n_legger._note: count=5 is a guess -- adjust freely. Could also ship as a tiered family (3/5/7) instead of one quest.

im_not_leaving.title: I'm Not Leaving!!
im_not_leaving.description: Ride one subway line from end to end in a single trip.
im_not_leaving._note: Route-agnostic -- any single line ridden fully end-to-end within one trip's legs qualifies.

wordsmith.title: Wordsmith
wordsmith.description: Log a trip whose ridden line letters spell J-A-M, in order.
wordsmith._note: Picked JAM since J/A/M are all real single-letter/valid route IDs and it's short enough to be achievable. Totally your call to swap for a different word -- just needs to only use letters that are real route IDs (no H/I/K/O/P/T/U/V/X/Y exist as subway line letters).

top_to_bottom.title: Top to Bottom
top_to_bottom.description: Ride from Manhattan's northern tip to its southern tip in one trip.
top_to_bottom._note: start=215 St (1 train, northernmost mainline Manhattan complex), end=Whitehall St-South Ferry. Deliberately avoided Marble Hill as the start given its borough ambiguity. Adjust freely.

bottom_to_top.title: Bottom to Top
bottom_to_top.description: Ride from Manhattan's southern tip to its northern tip in one trip.

side_to_side.title: Side to Side
side_to_side.description: Ride across Manhattan at 125th St, west side to east side, in one trip.
side_to_side._note: start=125 St (Broadway 1 train, west), end=125 St (Lexington Av 4/5/6, east) -- same street, opposite edges of the island. Adjust freely if a different crosstown pair reads better.
